text: Rēctē. Plusquamperfectum coniūnctīvī rem ante interrogātiōnem praeteritam factam exprimit; imperfectum rem eōdem tempore indicāret.
Rēctē. Interrogātiō oblīqua coniūnctīvum postulat; indicātīvus interrogātiōnis rēctae hīc nōn servātur.
